name: Cape Adventure Playground
description: An adventure playground at 85 Crouch Hill. Run by Awesome Adventure Play for children aged 6 and over who live or go to school in Islington (register with them first). Term time: Monday to Friday 3:15pm to 6:15pm; Saturday Family Play for all ages with a parent or carer, 11:30am to 4:30pm.
